tagline: Find a career that fits you
subtitle: Based on your interests, skills and education. Free.
privacyShort: No name, phone or Aadhaar needed. Your answers stay on your phone unless you choose to share them.
profileNeed: Please choose education, district and age to continue.
skillsIntro: Tell us what you can already do.
suggestions: Did we find your skills? Tap to add.
noMatch: No match found. Try other words or search below.
matchNote: Suggestions come from simple text matching. Please check each one.
levelLabel: How well do you know it?
needOne: Add at least one skill to continue.
quizIntro: Answer 3 questions for each of up to {n} of your skills. Your level is then set from your answers.
noQuiz: There are no questions for your skills yet. Continue to see results.
fitNote: Fit shows how many of the required skills you already have, with a small weight for your interests. It is a guide, not a guarantee.
noCareers: No careers match your education level yet.
noGaps: You already meet every required level.
learnNote: General sites: open them and search for the skill. Exact courses are not checked yet.
schemeNote: Check the official site for current rules and eligibility.
shareText: Share an anonymous summary: district, education, best career match and skill gaps. No name or phone number.
consentLabel: I agree to share this anonymously
parentLabel: My parent or guardian agrees (needed under 18)
shareFail: Could not reach the server. Please try again later.
backendOffline: Server not reachable. The app still works; sharing needs the server.
